```plato
//==
// # Time arithmetic
//
// Affine Instant / Duration operations for the types of `time.types.plato`.
// Instants are positions on a time line; Durations are differences between
// them — deliberately distinct from Number (same discipline as Size2D vs
// Vector2D in `intervals.types.plato`). Duration already discharges its
// IQuantity obligations via `quantities.library.plato` / Amount-FromAmount in
// `quantities.library.plato`; this file adds Instant IDifference
// and IComparable fills, plus the Duration↔Number and Duration/Duration
// operators that IQuantity alone does not cover.

library Time
{
    //==
    // Instant — the two IOriginBased<Duration> conversions, plus IComparable.
    // The epoch IS the origin, so the conversions are the same field under its
    // two names: seconds since the epoch, and a span of seconds.
    //
    // Add, Between, Subtract (both spellings) and Lerp are all derived over the
    // IDifference and IOriginBased interfaces in algebra.library.plato. Between keeps the
    // b - a orientation, matching the point types. Instant gains interpolation
    // and an Origin (the epoch, now nameable) it never had. The commuted
    // Add(Duration, Instant) stays concrete: library dispatch is on the first
    // parameter, which must be a concrete type or interface, so a generic
    // reversed-operand form cannot be written.

    // The instant's displacement from the epoch.
    Offset(t: Instant): Duration
        => new Duration(t.SecondsSinceEpoch);
```
